exam.exam_name: Indian Navy Direct Entry Petty Officer / Chief Petty Officer (Sports Quota Recruitment)
exam.conducting_body: The Directorate of Naval Physical Training and Sports (DNPTS), IHQ MoD (Navy), New Delhi

source_evidence.captured_wording: Candidate must provide recent passport size colour photograph with light blue background holding black slate with candidate name and date taken written in white chalk.
source_evidence.document_title: Notification: Recruitment of Outstanding Sportsmen as Direct Entry Petty Officer and Chief Petty Officer

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.

unsupported_requirement_reasons: The body requires the candidate's name and/or the photograph date printed on the image. The engine has no text-rendering capability, so the photograph is produced correctly sized and composed but without the imprint, which the candidate must add before uploading.

requirements.requirement_name: Candidate Passport Photograph with Slate (Name & Date in Chalk)
requirements.content_instructions: JPG / JPEG; Preferred 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; Plain light blue background; Recent photograph against light blue background holding black slate with candidate name and date in chalk; ears visible
JPG / JPEG; Preferred 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm; 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm; Plain white background; Running handwriting on plain white paper; Signature must match across trials and verification

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.

requirements.content_instructions: PDF; Clear legible PDF document; A4; Document scan; Representation at International/National/Senior State/Inter-University sports competitions
PDF; Clear legible PDF document; A4; Document scan; Matriculation / 10+2 certificate showing proof of age and academic eligibility

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Notification: Recruitment of Outstanding Sportsmen as Direct Entry Petty Officer and Chief Petty Officer - Section: Application Guidelines (https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/files/files/Sports_Quota_Sailor_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Notification: Recruitment of Outstanding Sportsmen as Direct Entry Petty Officer and Chief Petty Officer - Section: Application Guidelines (https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/files/files/Sports_Quota_Sailor_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
